time.heading: Time
time.empty: No time logged on this task yet.
time.loadFailed: Could not load time entries. The form below still works, and your entry will save.
time.durationHint: Minutes, decimal hours, or hours and minutes.
time.dateFixedToToday: Entries are dated today. Logging against another day needs a date on the create endpoint.
time.logForOthersGate: You can log your own time. Logging for someone else needs manage team time.

time.localOnlyWarning: These settings are saved in this browser only. They will move to the workspace once the time settings endpoint lands, and anyone else opening Flow sees the defaults until then.
time.overtimeBelowTarget: The overtime threshold cannot be below the weekly target, or an ordinary week would warn.
time.approvalLocksExplained: On: an approved entry is read-only, and a manager has to unapprove it before anyone can change it. Off: it stays editable, and an edit returns it to pending.
time.lockConsequence: Turning this on does not lock entries that are already approved. Turning it off does not unlock what is already locked. Both are irreversible for entries that exist now.
time.autoLockExplained_one: Entries lock {{count}} day after the week closes, whichever way the switch is set. This is what makes Finance's pull safe.
time.autoLockExplained_other: Entries lock {{count}} days after the week closes, whichever way the switch is set. This is what makes Finance's pull safe.
time.categoriesNotWired: Categories are saved here but nothing reads them yet: a time entry has no category field, so an entry cannot be filed under one.
time.ratesOnePerPerson: One rate per person. The per-project column is deliberately empty: per-project rates arrive as a value in that cell, not as a rewrite of this table.

board.readOnlyReason: You can see this board's setup but not change it. Column and card settings need manage project.
board.removeColumnConfirm: Remove {{name}}? Its tasks move to the first column.
board.lastColumnProtected: A board keeps at least one column, because a task has to sit somewhere.
board.wipLimitBlocked: WIP limits cannot be saved yet: a column stores only its name, colour and order.
board.promptsForHoursBlocked: Which column prompts for hours cannot be saved yet: a column has no flag for it, so the prompt would be fixed to the column named Done.
board.cardFieldsBlocked: Card fields cannot be saved yet. These are settings your whole team sees, and there is nowhere shared to keep them.
board.scopeExplained: Grouping is yours alone and follows you per project. Columns and card fields are shared, so changing them changes what your team sees.
